estimand: conditional 128-step frozen-policy gain on later natural recurrence
statistical_unit: seed within budget; candidates and recurrence replicates are not independent seeds

protocol.score_freeze: all write_tests within the first 6 bouts and step <= 12288, before any recurrence
protocol.primary_target_weighting: equal weight over unique source contexts in the scored archive
protocol.recurrence_design: four actual recurrence state anchors at offsets 0, 64, 128, and 192; 8 paired runs x 128 raw steps per policy arm
protocol.common_randomness: common per-step action uniforms and reset-ordinal seeds
protocol.intervals: pointwise 95% Student t intervals with 7 degrees of freedom over paired replicate aggregates
protocol.interval_scope: conditional on the observed contexts and recurrence anchors; pointwise intervals are not simultaneous across candidates
protocol.sign_rule: beneficial if CI low > 0; harmful if CI high < 0; otherwise ambiguous
protocol.scope_limit: conditional frozen-policy gain only; not adaptation, final return, complete write benefit, or long-term online effect
protocol.inference_limit: no p-values, no confidence interval across seeds, and no pooling seed-by-budget cells as independent seeds

config.primary_outcome: unique historical context equal-weight conditional 128-step frozen-policy reward/raw-step gain

favorable_heuristic.criterion: exploratory heuristic: both budgets must have all 3 seed cells estimable, mean primary rho >= 0.3, at least 2 of 3 positive seed rhos, and mean partial rho controlling group > 0
